sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully implements the required owner paths, applicability and branch-selection evidence, controlled patch orientation, magnitude-based plastic-strength definition with expected-value-scaled tolerance, quantity datatypes and units, and unit-compatible demand-versus-strength comparison.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair two semantic defects using the supplied terms. First, prevent applicability from passing when branch-selection evidence is missing: require each linked localFrame to provide structuralLocation, and require a sideStructureLocation local frame to provide a boolean transverseFrameOrientation before deciding whether the transverse-side branch applies. Second, encode the definition as plasticStrength equal to the magnitude of midspanPlasticCollapseLoad, not the signed raw value; calculate the expected value from ABS(midspan collapse load) (or an equivalent min/max expression) and scale the existing tolerance from that expected magnitude.

Prevent unit-dependent accidental passes in the demand-versus-strength comparison. Each combinedShearAndBendingDemand quantity must have exactly one qudt:unit, and the comparison must reject the case unless that unit equals the compared plasticStrength quantity's unit; currently a missing or incompatible demand unit can pass through a raw numeric comparison. Do not guess a standalone canonical recommended unit for the demand. Preserve the corrected branch-selection evidence checks and the magnitude-based ABS(midspanPlasticCollapseLoad) tolerance calculation.

Candidate faithfully implements the required owner paths, applicability and branch-selection evidence, controlled patch orientation, magnitude-based plastic-strength definition with expected-value-scaled tolerance, quantity datatypes and units, and unit-compatible demand-versus-strength comparison.
